expected.planIntro: You're already doing more than you think. Here's what to focus on first.
whatWeHeard: You've noticed changes in Dad, but there's no diagnosis yet.
You share it with a brother or sister, and you work part-time.
What worries you most: not knowing what comes next.

beforeAfter.before: Today: you've noticed changes in Dad and aren't sure what they mean or how to bring them up.
beforeAfter.after: In 30 days: you know what's worth raising with a doctor, you've had a calm talk with Dad, and you have phrases that work when the same questions come up.

modules.title: Talking with Dad
modules.reason: Everyone starts here. Calm conversations help now, before and after any diagnosis.

modules.title: Before the diagnosis
modules.reason: Because there's no diagnosis yet. These steps help you understand what's happening and talk to a doctor.

modules.title: Hard moments
modules.reason: The same pattern, used when emotions run higher.

modules.title: While he can still decide
modules.reason: Papers, money and driving are easier to sort out while Dad can take part.

modules.title: Safe home, calmer days
modules.reason: Small changes at home make days safer and calmer.

modules.title: Doctors and your care team
modules.reason: Get more from doctor visits and share the load with others.

modules.title: Caring for yourself
modules.reason: Caring for Dad works better when you rest too.

modules.title: Getting more help
modules.reason: For when Dad needs more help than you can give alone.

modules.title: Later stages
modules.reason: Comfort, connection and the conversations families need, when the time comes.
